associations.rationale: The theorem gives the cardinality of the combined constructed index family by a sum that simplifies to q squared minus one, but it does not itself state simplicity or pairwise nonisomorphism of the family.
The theorem states pairwise nonisomorphism of the constructed family, but it does not itself state the family's cardinality, simplicity, or its decomposition into the three named kinds.
